reviewer: Claude（Claude Code 会话）：faster-whisper small.en 与 medium.en 两档逐词转写交叉核对，并对照本地抽帧；未人工听音

foreground_english.en: The past 18 years I've done it every day,
and just not being able to do that,
and just feeling so like I couldn't do the basic of things.
foreground_english.zh: 连最基本的事都做不到。

foreground_english.en: I couldn't brush my teeth without almost standing back up and just being in agony.
foreground_english.zh: 刷牙都得马上直起腰，疼得要命。

foreground_english.en: So it was definitely a tough injury,
foreground_english.zh: 这真的是一次难熬的伤，

foreground_english.en: but it's definitely made me a stronger person,
and hopefully it'll make me a better tennis player.
foreground_english.zh: 希望也让我成为更好的球员。

review_note: 英国网协 LTA 官方频道复出专访「The Comeback is ON | Sonay Kartal's Road Back From Injury」（8u0X2vm7svU，4K）：她坐着讲伤病。两档逐词一致（medium 113.82–143.02；small 114.02–143.00，small 把 all I've known 记成 what I've known、多一个 kind of，按 medium 写）。镜头 40.36 切入、174.72 切走，段首 115.8 在 tennis is all I've known, right（113.82–115.52）之后、The past（116.04）之前，段尾 143.5 在主持人下一问（143.66）之前。
